🌟 wifi-card | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create a physical, shareable card with WiFi credentials via a QR code for easy guest access.
✨ Key Features: • Generate QR code for WiFi login details • Printable card format • Supports multiple languages • Local development environment with Docker • Prettier for code formatting and pre-commit hooks
📖 Summary: This JavaScript project, wificard.io, allows users to easily generate and print a physical card containing their WiFi network's login details. It's designed for convenient sharing of WiFi access with guests or household members by presenting the information in a scannable QR code format.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Unity-MCP | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: Integrating and developing AI-powered features within the Unity game engine, streamlining the AI development lifecycle for game developers.
✨ Key Features: • AI Skills and MCP Tools for Unity Engine • Full AI development and testing loop • CLI for quick setup • Efficient token usage • Advanced AI tools
📖 Summary: Unity-MCP is a C# toolkit for Unity Engine that integrates AI capabilities, enabling developers to create and test AI-driven features within games. It supports a full AI development loop and offers efficient token usage, advanced tools, and seamless integration with various AI models and IDEs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 whosthere | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Discovering and understanding devices on a local area network through an intuitive TUI.
✨ Key Features: • Interactive TUI • Fast & Concurrent scanning • No Elevated Privileges Required • Device Enrichment with OUI lookup • Integrated Port Scanner
📖 Summary: Whosthere is a Go-based Local Area Network discovery tool that provides an interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) for exploring network devices. It uses multiple unprivileged scanning techniques like mDNS, SSDP, and ARP cache analysis to identify devices and enriches this information with OUI lookups for manufacturer details.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 intercept | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Consolidating and providing a unified interface for a diverse set of radio frequency (RF) and signal intelligence tools for monitoring, tracking, decoding, and analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Pager Decoding (POCSAG/FLEX) • 433MHz Sensor Decoding (rtl_433) • Sub-GHz RF Analysis • Aircraft Tracking (ADS-B) • Vessel Tracking (AIS)
📖 Summary: iNTERCEPT is an open-source, web-based platform that unifies various signal intelligence (SIGINT) tools into a single interface. It supports a wide range of functionalities from radio decoding and tracking to counter-surveillance and space weather monitoring.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 zen | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A self-hosted, lightweight, and portable note-taking application for managing personal knowledge.
✨ Key Features: • Single Go binary or Docker Compose • Low resource usage • Standard Markdown files, local SQLite database • Organize with flexible tags • Full-text search with BM25 ranking
📖 Summary: Zen is a self-hosted notes application that stores notes as Markdown files in a local SQLite database. It offers features like full-text search, flexible tagging, and data portability, all within a single, low-resource binary.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
